name: Centered Camera
description: Centres the player horizontally on Red/Blue/Yellow and Gold/Silver/Crystal. The Game Boy screen is 10 tiles wide -- an even count, with no middle column -- so the ROM parks the player in column 4, 8 pixels left of true centre. This nudges the camera 8 pixels left so the player's tile straddles the centre line exactly, at any zoom, tilt or phone-fill view size. Vertical framing is left alone: 9 rows is odd, so the ROM was already true there. FireRed/LeafGreen/Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald are already centred on both axes, so nothing is corrected there; the nudges still work as a taste bias. X CENTRE sets the GB correction (8 = true centre, 0 = vanilla). Y NUDGE biases the view up or down on every game. GBA X NUDGE biases Gen 3 left or right.
